title: Atomic and Molecular Mass
summary: The atomic mass unit, and adding up the atoms to find molecular and formula unit masses.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 9: Atomic Foundations of Matter

objectives: I can define the atomic mass unit.
I can calculate molecular masses and formula unit masses.
I can calculate the percentage of an element in a compound.
misconceptions: The molecular mass is the number of atoms.
Subscripts only apply to the element before them, even with brackets.
